title: EDG Community Update: Week of November 29th
body:
**Highlights**
- Introducing community-run ‘[EDG DAO Financial Bulletin](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/)’. 
- [The waitlist is now open for Kabocha](https://www.kabocha.network/), the Kusama parachain candidate from the Edgeware ecosystem.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-nov-28/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [4thTech’s FOURim](https://twitter.com/4thtechProject/status/1466748163906326536?s=20) (instant messaging) caching & encryption is now live.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [Kabocha Technical Steward - Treasury Proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/2515-kabocha-technical-steward-treasury-proposal/), [GMI it in crypto media](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series/).


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
- Recent/trending Community Research thread(s):
- [Enthusiast contributor](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/284
